title: Advantages of implementing business analytics in your organi
excerpt: Business analytics boosts decision-making with data insights, enhances efficiency, cuts costs, and finds growth chances. Requires data-driven culture.

body.text: Wednesday, June 19, 2024

Business Analytics has become an important function in every business organization: We all agree that it’s an era of customers and that era is not going anywhere. For many decades, post the invention of computers, there has been an intelligent breed of strategy makers who have always relied upon the power of bringing intelligence into business decision-making with the help of statistical tools and technologies by creating data sets for analytical decision-making. Business analytics, business intelligence & Data analytics, and big data & data science are some of the terms That are used interchangeably concerning understanding customers and their behavior but all of them have their specific definitions and meanings. I still remember My stint working with an IBM and Hyperion partner in India wherein, I first worked on a solution called Brio from Hyperion. It was a business intelligence tool platform, and I was involved in Pre-sales consulting and training of the solution to large system integrators like Wipro, Infosys, etc. I was also doing proof of concepts (POCs) With companies like indiatimes.com & Bharti Airtel Ltd. It was fun working with a large set of customer databases and trying to make some meaningful insights from them. It involved combining data coming from multiple tables and creating pivots and charts on a large set of databases, which was not possible via Excel sheets as a techno-functional consultant. The business intelligence reporting tools were costly & the manpower working on the solutions was scarce. Then business intelligence solutions were very high and technology solutions and CTO / CIOs were talking about it. I am talking about the years 2003-2004. However, a large number of traditional & B2B organizations were still unable to understand the advantages of business intelligent solutions. Today, in 2024, post the popularity of the term big data, Business intelligence solutions and data sciences are the most important strategic tools for organizations of any scale and size. These rules are required for a better understanding of customers' behavior, customer profitability, customer segmentation, and predicting all of these. Conceptually business analytics is of multiple types which include descriptive analytics, prescriptive analytics, and predictive analytics. These tools help you create dashboards and visualization of customer data for the easy understanding of the top management team members. The key executive gets real-time or near real-time Data and insights about customers, which becomes an important input for any business decision-making. However, it makes more sense for companies operating in BFSI, Telecom, e-commerce, utilities, Retail, FMCG, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) Industry a lot where the number and volume of customers are way beyond management. Still, few studies are emerging in other industries as well. The advantages of implementing business analytics solutions are manyfold. Some of these benefits are as follows: 1 Helps improve strategic decisions by evaluating and making informed choices. Business owners still make a lot of decisions based on Gut. With these tools and solutions, they have access to a lot of information and insight. 2 These solutions help in identifying Industry and customer trends and help you to draw patterns of similar trends and behavior. This is especially helpful in creating new products and services in adjusting the current ones to stay relevant in the market. 3 The solutions also help in driving better performance from existing teams and resources and help in increasing revenues. When you have access to real-time or near real-time reporting of performance at the global level you can better instruct teams and resources for improving performance in certain specific areas. 4 These solutions are costly to implement initially but in the long run, help in improving operational efficiency and reducing the cost of operations. There are innovative solutions from companies like Amazon to get the test of cloud-based analytics at very economical rates. 5 With the help of predictive analytics, organizations can find improvement opportunities through predictions in various workflows and processes. These predictions help in improving operations, reducing costs, and improving revenue. 6 The solutions enable your organization to be smarter with an excess of graphical dashboards, visualization, and drill-down charts with faster reporting. So, it helps the board of directors and key leadership team members to have a real pulse of the organization for faster intervention by monitoring KPIs from sales, marketing, customers, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance. These are the best ways to implement business analytics in your company 1 Have a companywide Business Intelligence and data analytics strategy. Companies should know their long-term goals, Current assessment of the RI infrastructure, and what they want to achieve. The company typically lies in 5 stages of data enablement and the stages are data Resistant, data-aware, Data guided, data-savvy & data-driven. 2 Discuss and gather Key Performance Indicators. Companies need to go beyond traditional KPIs Which are Sales, marketing, financial, project management, human resources, and customer hygiene factors. Companies should also look at ways to store and measure data around the speed of implementation of any new initiative, innovation, Employees' skill sets, learning index, and behavior, and how will they be prepared for any disruption. 3 Appoint team, consultants, trainers, stakeholders, and companies to start rolling out. If you don’t already have a business insights department or people responsible for the same, please create one. Depending upon the scale and size and budget availability, recruit team members and Consultants. BI core team members may include analysts, data mining experts, database admin, and data scientists and build a strong in-house business insights function. BI can answer Multiple questions: what, where why, and how. From a transformation perspective let them focus on the last two. “ To get qualified manpower for implementing business analytics in your organization. You can tie up with a leading IT training institution like Jetking Info train Ltd, which has several programs for big data and business analytics. You can easily find qualified manpower by contacting them. ” 4 Evaluate and select tools by doing multiple POCs in various functions with the help of different tools. There are a variety of tools available so depending upon the suitability of the tool from a business function perspective do the proof of concept Four multiple rules and depending upon the strategy of its usage for a particular and core business function go for that tool. 5 Create a reporting server, data storage, environment, and platform for business intelligence. You have multiple options to get OLTP, OLAP, relational databases, and data cubes. From silos of data lying all across your organization, you can create a structured data warehouse, reporting server, and data lake. You can choose from the on-premise server, cloud server, or even a hybrid strategy depending upon the criticality and confidentiality of the data. 6 Have functional experts or subject matter experts start gathering business requirements and preparing the data input process and workflow. The most important aspect of this stage is not only data quality but also defining the right set of questions that your business intelligence will answer. 7 Run advanced Statistical models and sophisticated analysis if need be. After creating reports and building hypotheses, we use advanced statistical modeling tools to create new frameworks and data models. 8 Roll out enterprise-wide dashboards to have ready and combined access to multiple BI systems such as Ad-hoc analysis, online electrical processing, and operational and Real-time business analytics. 9 Regularly monitor KPIs for improvement and have monthly meetings with the board on new insights developed that require their urgent attention. Business intelligence and data analytics have been there for ages but when we shift our focus to generating new insights about customers, products, and services and try to answer who and how-based questions, that is where start realizing the full potential of our business intelligence investment. Being a data-driven company ensures that major business decisions are backed up by Data logic rather than depending upon the gut and intuition-based decision of one key person Which may land the company in trouble. Author information. The above information is taken from a chapter of Mr. Ajay Chhabra‘s work-in-progress textbook on Digital Transformation. Ajay Chhabra is a veteran in the digital marketing industry in India with over 25 years of overall experience working with global digital marketing agencies and organizations. He is currently researching and working as a professor of practice in Digital Marketing at Woxsen University Hyderabad. He is also a visiting Professor at Flame University Pune, India. He can be reached at https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajaychhabra ​

title: Role of Zero Trust Architecture in cyber security
excerpt: Zero Trust Architecture enhances security with strict access controls and continuous verification, minimizing attacks, protecting data,and supporting compliance

body.text: Monday, July 01, 2024

Introduction If you are the CIO or CTO, tasked with building a multi-layered cyber security mechanism for your organization, which is a multi-country, and people are using multiple devices that they bring from home (BYOD), and you are handling a hybrid workforce. So, some of those individuals work from home, and some work from the office. Then it becomes very crucial for you to create a multi-layered cyber security mechanism that can protect your company its data and its reputation. Here are some solutions for building this multitier cyber security layer: 1. Implement Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA): Zero Trust architecture or ZTA assumes that no entity in your organization network can be trusted by default, so it means enforcing strict access control methods and continuous verification of logins and access requests. This is one of the most important cyber security protocols used by many organizations in the current context of cyber threats and security breaches. 2. Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR): organizations' networks are continuously under cyber threat by hackers, so endpoint deduction and response known as EDR solutions continuously monitor and collect data from various user endpoints and devices to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber security threats. They provide real-time visibility and analytics to identify and mitigate potential cyber security and cyber threat risks. 3. Extended Detection and Response (XDR): if you want to take your cyber security to the next level, you need to integrate multiple layers into one and have a unified view of the extended deduction and response known as XDR helps you do the, it integrates data from multiple security layers—such as various endpoints, computer networks, and cloud computing and Hosting environment. XDR provides a very advanced and unified view and cyber security threat detection capabilities. These are a must for multinational or multicountry organizations, which cannot afford data outages or security breaches. 4. Cyber Threat Intelligence systems: since organizations are under cyber threat, 24×7, so they need to deploy a new category of cyber threat intelligence, utilizing threat intelligence solutions, and platforms helps organizations stay informed about the latest cyber-attacks cyber threats, potential vulnerabilities, and attack attempts by the hackers. This information can be used to proactively defend against emerging cyber security, breaches and threats. It is highly imperative that one should explore and deploy cyber threats, intelligence, systems, and platforms for the safety of your network. So having a firewall used to be a great solution in the past now not anymore. 5. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): users need to work on Systems all the time, and they need access, and for granting access. One password and username are not. Multi-factor authentication popularly known as MFA adds a layer of security by requiring corporate network users to provide multiple forms of verification methods and factors before granting access to the requested resources in the corporate network. This solution and practice reduce the risk of unauthorized access due to compromised credentials and weak passwords which anyone can guess and breach into the corporate networks. 6. Data Encryption: we have all heard of SSL, which is a protocol for cryptic and decrypting data while it is being transformed from the user machine to the server or vice versa. While it is being transferred, it is still under threat, and if it is not encrypted anybody cuts in intercept and makes sense of the data. Data Encrypting is needed, both at rest and while in transit as it ensures that even if data is intercepted or accessed by unauthorized users, it remains unreadable and secure. This can help prevent theft of data and being leaked onto the dark web. So that description is a must in both rest and transit mode, even while transferring the data to cloud security systems, the data must be scripted in a particular file format so that only the user device who uploaded the data shall be able to decrypt the same. Some of the leading cloud computing platforms provide this functionality as one of their court features. 7. Identity and Access Management (IAM): Not everyone in the system is required to be an admin and it’s always a best practice to have identity and access based on the user role on the project. I Identity and management systems known as IAM solutions can help manage multiple user identities, and multiple-level roles help enforce access policies, and rules and ensure that all users have appropriate rights and access to Network and file Resources based on their current role roles and privileges. By combining some of these solutions and adopting a proactive, comprehensive. A Multitier, cyber security approach can help organizations to better defend against contemporary cyber threats and reduce their overall cyber risk exposure. Let’s understand the advantages of zero-trust architecture solutions and how they’re beneficial in building the multilayered cybersecurity mechanism for your organization. Advantages of implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in improving cybersecurity: 1. Enhanced Cyber Security: By not trusting any entity or user by default, zero trust architecture reduces the risk of unauthorized access by potential hackers and safeguards the computer networks against potential breaches. Every access request is always verified as a new request, making it harder for attackers to move freely and laterally within the network even if they have entered by breaching the security. 2. Minimized Cyber Attack: The inherent principle of least privilege access limits the exposure of sensitive user resources. This means even if an attacker gains access, their ability to cause damage is restricted. ZTA provides Improved Visibility and Control over Continuous monitoring. ZTA provides real-time threat and cyber security analytics that give CIOs and cyber security experts better insights into any user activities and network traffic. This helps in detecting anomalies and responding to threats swiftly. 3. Enhanced customer data security and adherence to compliances: A lot of countries, are now adapting to new data privacy bills as for them. The customers, personal, and financial information is of utmost security and the organization should work on only first-party data. Adopting rural architecture or ZTA can help organizations meet regulatory requirements and standards such as GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS by ensuring strict access controls and data protection measures. This not only saves the customer data from bridges but also helps avoid penalties which these new laws and regulations bring to the table. Due to GDPR getting into an agreement with a European country is very very difficult time time-consuming and cost-intensive. I was personally involved in signing up a GDPR questionnaire for a Germany-based company, and I know the rounds of legal discussions that we had done before getting into the agreement for a small commercial project. 4. ZTA helps in Better Data Protection: Encrypting data both in transit and at rest ensures that sensitive information remains secure, even if it is intercepted or accessed by unauthorized users. ZTA also Supports for Modern Work Environment where organizations are allowing and adopting remote workforce and BYOD (Bring Your Device) policies, ZTA provides secure access regardless of the user's location or device. Overall, it helps build Resilience Against Advanced Threats and even can prevent the most sophisticated cyber breaches. Overall, implementing Zero Trust Architecture helps you build a very strong component of your multitier, cyber security defense mechanism for your organization. title: Why upskilling in cloud computing is a must for Indian Profe

body.text: Thursday, July 25, 2024

Introduction Cloud computing has become a key tool in today's quickly changing digital landscape, transforming industries and spurring innovation. Upskilling in cloud computing is not only advantageous for Indian workers but also essential. These are the main causes for this. Growing need for expertise in the cloud Numerous industries are experiencing a sharp increase in demand for cloud computing knowledge. Cloud technology plays a crucial role in enabling agility, scalability, and creativity in digital transformation activities, which are commonly prioritized by enterprises. Businesses understand they need specialized workers like cloud developers, administrators, and security specialists to remain competitive. The increased demand serves as a reminder of how important cloud computing is in contemporary workplaces. Bridging the Skill Gap The labor market still has a sizable skills gap even if the demand for cloud knowledge is rising. Upskilling is crucial since there is a significant gap between the supply and demand of cloud workers. Around 2 million cloud specialists will be needed in India by 2025, according to predictions, to fulfill the growing demand in industries like IT, finance, and healthcare. To provide the existing workforce with the skills it needs to close this gap, an upskilling initiative is essential. Improving opportunities for a cloud computing career Developing one’s skills in cloud computing not only meets industry demands but also greatly improves one’s professional opportunities. Experts in the cloud are more in demand by businesses and frequently fetch more compensation. More training in this area may result in promotions and greater work chances given the increasing emphasis on cloud-based solutions. Proficiency in cloud computing is an advantageous trait for individuals seeking to progress in their professions. Efficiency in operation and forward-looking. Cloud technologies increase productivity and save expenses, which leads to an improvement in operational efficiency. Experts in cloud computing can optimize processes, offering significant advantages as companies grow. Additionally, keeping up with the latest technological developments through upskilling enables workers to future-proof their professionals. Following the most recent developments in cloud computing guarantees their continued relevance in a constantly evolving work environment. Impact of the Pandemic The COVID-19 epidemic increased the shift to remote work and led to a considerable increase in the use of cloud computing services. Businesses made significant investments in cloud technologies to sustain operations and productivity during lockdowns. Professionals with expertise in cloud services and digital tools are becoming more and more in demand as this trend continues. To fulfill the new operational demands defined by the pandemic's effects on the workplace, cloud computing upskilling is essential. An initiative from the Government and businesses Proposals from the government, such as the Digital India Program, support professional development in digital technologies, particularly cloud computing. The objectives of these initiatives are to boost economic growth and operational efficiency. In addition, as businesses adjust to the digital transition, many are placing high priority on employee training. This highlights the significance of cloud computing skills in the contemporary job market and underlines the urgent need for upskilling across the workforce. title: How Can I Start a Career in Hardware Networking?
excerpt: Start a career in hardware networking with Jetking’s expert training, hands-on experience, certifications like CCNA, and specialization in cloud networking.

body.text: Saturday, October 05, 2024

Introduction Hardware networking is the most in-demand skill in terms of infrastructure, from simple personal devices to vast global infrastructures, in the lightning-speed digital world today. This blog will take you through a step-by-step journey in a very rewarding career in hardware networking. Step 1: Get a Good Base in Hardware Networking Fundamentals A good foundation for building a network means that one needs to start by learning the more complex aspects of hardware networking. Hardware Networking is concerned with the basic, physical infrastructure that connects computers, servers, and other devices in such a manner that they may efficiently communicate with one another. This includes routers, switches, cables, and all devices that make networks function efficiently. Key concepts to grasp include: - Types of networks (LAN, WAN, MAN) - Network protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS) - Network topologies and configurations Courses in basic networking or entry-level certifications like CompTIA Network+ can lay the necessary foundation. Jetking's BCA program (Bachelor of Computer Applications) provides a solid grounding with exposure to all basic IT fundamentals besides an overall introduction to networking. Know more about Jetking's BCA program. This will provide the much-needed foundation to stand strong in hardware networking, having been drafted according to the current industry demand. Step 2: Obtain Core Networking Certifications Not only do certifications validate your skills and make you stand apart in an already competitive job market, but they are also very integral to the hardware networking process. Among some of the most recognized include: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA): Know it to be one taken as a must in the industry, proving you know how to install, configure, and troubleshoot the networks. Major credential that employers look for. CompTIA Network+: Good starting point that covers foundational concepts of networking. Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Fundamentals: Glimpse into managing server infrastructure. Each of these certifications enhances your resume, signaling your competence in hardware networking. Step 3: Gain Practical Experience Theoretical knowledge will only take you so far. In a field like hardware networking, hands-on experience is key. Seek internships, entry-level jobs, or freelance opportunities where you can work on actual networking tasks, such as setting up routers, switches, and firewalls, troubleshooting network issues, and performing regular network maintenance. Jetking’s practical lab sessions simulate real-world scenarios, helping students build confidence in working with networking equipment and solving problems in real-time. Step 4: Specialize in an Area of Interest It can be a really broad field of hardware networking; hence, specialization is what can better sharpen focus and deepen expertise. Some of the sought-after specializations include the following: Network Security: This is one of the critical specializations since cyber threats have also become a common phenomenon. The focus of this particular area is on maintaining the security of data and ensuring that the network sounds. Wireless Networking: Those experts will hold value while more devices connect to the world through wireless networks. Cloud Networking: The proliferation of cloud computing has started to change the landscape of networking, and knowing how to take advantage of cloud-based networks and how to manage them is certainly a future-proof skill. Specializing is what refines your skills, and above all, enhances your marketability, thus making you more attractive to employers. Step 5: Track emerging technologies Since networking technologies are changing rapidly, one needs to be updated as well to remain at the forefront of the competition curve. The influx of AI, Cloud Computing, 5G, and IoT is changing the domain of networking in a way that demands new skill sets to navigate through such advancements. Jetking ensures it's in line with the most updated technological trends and keeps the students abreast of cloud-based networking tools and AI-based security protocols. Step 6: Build a Professional Network Networking in the professional sense can be as important as learning the technical aspects of hardware networking. Try to join forums, attend webinars, and participate in industry conferences to meet other professionals and learn from each other about opportunities and developments. Building relationships through sites like LinkedIn could help you unlock doors to job opportunities, mentoring, and collaborations. Step 7: Get Job Hunting Under Way Once you gain the required skill, certificate, and experience; then you need to initiate an application process. The demand for hardware networking professionals is increasing rapidly in India across the industries: IT, telecommunication, banking, and even governmental departments. Entry-level positions: - Network Administrator - IT Support Specialist - System engineer - Network Technician In addition, Jetking has a relationship set up with over 5000+ recruiters who would send the students to top employers. Moreover, Jetking provides a 100% job guarantee to teach you skills and get you a job in an industry. Why Jetking? For more than seven decades, Jetking has been the IT training pioneer; it has always provided world-class education regarding networking, cloud computing, and cybersecurity. Want to do a BCA or specialized courses in AI or certification for CCNA? The highest of your aims shall be achieved and supported through Jetking's latest curriculum along with practical lab training. Other than the networking courses, Jetking offers other courses for future-advanced chip design, metaverse development, ethical hacking, and Cyber Security. All these are short, time-to-take courses that make upskilling within the techno-changing landscape very fast. Conclusion ​Pursuing a career in hardware networking is very rewarding and future-proof. Noted below is the roadmap that should be followed for pursuing such a career-starting with foundational knowledge, earning key certifications, gaining hands-on experience, and keeping abreast of emerging technologies. With its rich legacy and comprehensive training programs, Jetking is the ideal partner for this journey, making all that you need available to you to excel in hardware networking. ​ Read our blogs I Visit our courses .

title: Top 10 Best Free AI Tools for Video and Image Creation

body.text: Monday, October 07, 2024

The rise of AI has revolutionized the way we create visual content. In 2024, both individuals and businesses are increasingly turning to AI tools for producing stunning images and videos with minimal effort. Whether you are a content creator, a marketer, or simply someone looking to enhance your digital presence, there are numerous free AI tools available that can help streamline your creative process. Below, we explore the top 10 best free AI tools for video and image creation in 2024. 1. Canva Best For: Beginners and professional marketers Platform: Web, iOS, Android Canva is a widely popular platform for designing visual content, and its AI-powered features make it even better in 2024. With the integration of AI design tools like Magic Resize and Background Remover, Canva enables users to create high-quality images and videos effortlessly. Its drag-and-drop interface and pre-made templates allow even beginners to design professional visuals in minutes. Moreover, Canva’s free version provides an impressive range of stock photos, videos, and design elements. Key Features: AI-based background remover Magic Resize for adapting designs to different dimensions Extensive library of templates, images, and videos Collaborative tools for teams 2. Runway ML Best For: Advanced video creation and VFX Platform: Web Runway ML is an advanced AI tool designed for video creators who want to add unique visual effects and manipulate content with AI-driven precision. In 2024, Runway ML is equipped with powerful features like video inpainting (removing unwanted elements from video) and AI-generated video effects. Its intuitive interface allows you to use complex machine learning models without any technical expertise. Key Features: Real-time video editing and effect generation Background removal in video content AI-powered video inpainting and object replacement Accessible for non-technical users Read this also: Top 10 Best Low-Budget Laptops for Hacking in 2024 3. DALL·E 3 Best For: Generating artistic images Platform: Web DALL·E 3, developed by OpenAI, is a game-changing AI tool that generates images based on text prompts. It stands out for creating imaginative and creative artwork, making it perfect for content creators, designers, and artists. As of 2024, DALL·E 3 offers improved image quality, consistency, and realism compared to its predecessors. Its unique ability to interpret complex text prompts into images allows users to visualize their ideas in ways they never could before. Key Features: Text-to-image generation based on detailed prompts High-quality, realistic images Enhanced control over artistic styles and compositions 4. Pictory Best For: Turning text into videos Platform: Web Pictory is a fantastic AI tool for transforming long-form text content into engaging videos, making it a favorite among content marketers and bloggers in 2024. By simply uploading your article or blog post, Pictory creates a video summary with visuals, transitions, and voiceovers. It’s ideal for turning written content into visually appealing marketing assets or social media videos. Key Features: AI-driven video creation from text content Automatic selection of relevant video clips and images Built-in voiceover feature Customizable video templates 5. Lumen5 Best For: Social media video creation Platform: Web Lumen5 continues to be one of the go-to AI video creation tools in 2024. Its AI engine analyzes text and automatically suggests visuals, music, and transitions to turn content into engaging videos. Lumen5 is perfect for social media managers and marketers looking to create videos that are tailor-made for platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Key Features: AI-assisted video creation from blog posts or scripts Thousands of pre-designed video templates Easy social media integration Free tier offers ample functionality for basic video creation 6. Deep Dream Generator Best For: AI art and style transfer Platform: Web Deep Dream Generator is a unique AI tool that generates dreamlike, surreal images by applying artistic styles to your existing photos. In 2024, it remains a favorite for artists and creators looking to explore AI-assisted creativity. The platform uses neural networks to analyze and enhance images in visually stunning ways, making it perfect for artistic projects. Key Features: AI-based artistic style transfer Large selection of filters and effects Easy-to-use interface for creating unique, artistic visuals Free version with high-quality output options 7. HitPaw Video Enhancer Best For: Enhancing low-resolution videos Platform: Web HitPaw Video Enhancer is an AI-driven tool that enhances video quality by upscaling low-resolution content and improving clarity. In 2024, it’s widely used by video editors and marketers to enhance the quality of their videos without needing advanced editing skills. The AI upscaling feature automatically adjusts video resolution, making blurry videos crisp and clear. Key Features: AI-based video upscaling Noise reduction and clarity improvement One-click enhancement process Free trial version available with basic features 8. Artbreeder Best For: Generating and mixing images Platform: Web Artbreeder is a creative AI platform that enables users to generate images by mixing and modifying existing ones. In 2024, it remains a popular choice for artists, designers, and game developers. The platform uses machine learning to combine images and create new, unique versions. Whether you need character portraits, landscapes, or abstract designs, Artbreeder offers endless possibilities. Key Features: AI-based image blending and customization Creation of portraits, landscapes, and abstract art Simple interface for non-designers Free access to basic features and downloads 9. Designify Best For: Quick image background removal and editing Platform: Web Designify is an AI-powered tool that focuses on removing image backgrounds, making it an ideal tool for e-commerce, marketers, and designers in 2024. It automates the process of extracting objects from their backgrounds with pixel-perfect precision, allowing users to place them on different scenes or use them in promotional material. Key Features: Instant background removal High-resolution downloads Free to use with basic editing features Ideal for creating transparent PNG images 10. Kapwing Best For: Collaborative video editing Platform: Web Kapwing is a web-based AI tool that offers a variety of video editing features and collaborative tools. It is widely used by teams for creating marketing videos, tutorials, and social media content. In 2024, Kapwing remains one of the best free tools due to its seamless integration of AI and editing capabilities. Its AI-powered tools can automatically generate subtitles, resize videos for different platforms, and more. Key Features: AI-generated subtitles and translations Collaborative video editing workspace Easy-to-use timeline and editing tools Free tier with significant features Conclusion: ​In 2024, creating high-quality video and image content has never been easier, thanks to the rapid advancements in AI technology. Whether you are a professional content creator, a marketer, or a hobbyist, these top 10 free AI tools can help you create stunning visuals and videos with minimal effort. From AI-driven video generation to artistic style transfers, these tools provide endless possibilities for enhancing your creativity while saving time and resources. ​ To get more Information about Cloud Computing with AI courses Visit on our official site. ​ FAQs: ​ Are these tools completely free to use? Most of the tools listed offer free versions with basic features. However, some may require paid subscriptions for advanced functionalities. Do I need technical expertise to use AI for video and image creation? No, most of these tools are designed to be user-friendly and accessible even for beginners. Can I use these AI tools for commercial projects? Yes, many of these AI tools allow for commercial use, but it's always a good idea to check their specific licensing terms. What are the limitations of free AI tools? Free versions often come with limitations like watermarks, limited resolution, or restricted access to premium features. Paid versions may be necessary for more professional needs. How do I choose the right tool for my needs? ​Consider the type of content you're creating (e.g., social media videos, artistic images) and the tool’s ease of use, output quality, and features.

body.text: Wednesday, October 09, 2024

Introduction Database Administration (DBA) is one of those IT areas that plays a really important role. Its activity mainly consists of managing databases through which very valuable sources of data could be accessed by various organizations. So, for all the students eager to begin their careers in this very area, one needs to know which firms offer the most promising opportunities. Here is the list of the top 10 companies that hire Database Administrators in India, offering promising career paths and professional growth. 1. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS): Overview TCS is one of the IT services companies in India. Being a leading company, its portfolio covers a wide range of services. It works with database management and other sectors. TCS provides an enjoyable work environment promoting innovation and skills growth. Why TCS?: Extensive training programs are provided, competitive pay, and global projects. Suitable for freshers and even experienced. 2. Infosys Infosys Overview Infosys, a recognized leader in technology innovation and digital transformation services, provides challenging projects that leverage the latest tools and technologies for its database administrators. Why Infosys? Good training programs, work-life balance, and international clients for work. The policies of Infosys are employee-centric. 3. Wipro Overview Wipro is a global information technology, consulting, and business process services company. DBAs at Wipro work on highly complex systems of databases ensuring they are free of vulnerabilities and have data integrity. Why Wipro?: It offers a highly diverse working environment with varied opportunities for professional growth across segments. Wipro offers learning and development programs that help strengthen technical as well as soft skills. 4. Accenture Accenture Overview Accenture is a professional services company providing a variety of different services, probably including database management. This service provides DBAs with the opportunity to be exposed to a wide range of industries, which broadens their experience. Why Accenture?: Accenture boasts a collaborative workplace, the latest technologies, and opportunities to learn. It offers great pay packages and performance incentives to its employees. 5. HCL Technologies Overview HCL is the top IT service company in India and offers a wide range of services, from database management. DBAs employed by HCL work on innovative solutions for clients from every different sector across the globe. Why HCL?: It provides a culture of continuous learning and skill development. HCL is offering a work environment in the global arena and an opportunity to engage in diverse projects. 6. IBM India Overview IBM is one of the world's leading technology companies that provides innovation in computing and data management. For a DBA, it offers the possibility to work with the most advanced database technologies and tools in IBM India. Why IBM India? IBM has always been known for its research-oriented approach. IBM provides challenging work environments, a competitive salary package, and professional growth opportunities. 7. Oracle India Overview: Oracle is one of the world leaders in database software and cloud services. Being a DBA at Oracle India calls for experience with some of the most technologically advanced database systems in the industry. Why Oracle India?: Extensive training programs and certifications. Very challenging work environment and opportunities to work on high-impact projects. 8. Capgemini Overview: Capgemini is a leader in consulting, technology services, and digital transformation. A DBA at Capgemini manages complex databases for various client industries. Why Capgemini?: This company has been known for a very supportive work culture, opportunities for learning and development, competitive salaries, and a diversified work environment. 9. Tech Mahindra Overview: One of the top companies in digital transformation, consulting, and business re-engineering, is Tech Mahindra. Here, DBAs work through the management and optimization of databases for clients worldwide. Why Tech Mahindra? It can offer a great teamwork environment, international exposure, and competitive remuneration packages. Focus on people's growth and development. 10. Cognizant Overview Cognizant is among the multinational IT services firms. This company avails to its clients various database management services. A DBA at Cognizant would gain experience in different projects hence working on several database technologies. Why Cognizant?: Dynamic work environment dedicated to innovation and skill building. House of well-designed professional development and career advancement programs. How to Become a Database Administrator 1. Qualifications Needed - Ordinarily, a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any other relevant discipline. - Certification as an Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) and Microsoft Certified Database Administrator (MCDBA) is a plus. 2. Technical Skills - The DBA should know SQL, database management systems (DBMS), and scripting with a programming language. - He or she should be aware of the various kinds of databases such as MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and NoSQL databases. 3. Practical Experience - Internships and entry-level positions are good in their own right, but one also needs the experience of hands-on work. - Take part in projects dealing with database design, implementations, and maintenance. 4. Learn Continuously - Database management is an ever-evolving field. Try to keep up with the latest trends and technologies. - Attend workshops, webinars, and industry conferences to improve knowledge. Why should one be a database administrator? High Demand: In the wake of the increasing volume of data, demand for experienced DBAs is highly on the rise every day. Lucrative Salaries: DBAs earn very handsome salaries, which increase as a DBA's career progresses in expertise and experience. Diverse Opportunities: DBAs in the domains of finance, health care, education, and technology. Continuous Learning: It offers the scope for continuous learning and learning skills. Your career will never get bored with it. Conclusion A career in Database Administration is promising and includes various scopes for growth and development. Of course, all the above-mentioned companies are among the best in India for DBAs, providing an environment at these institutions that allows for learning and professional advancement. For students wishing to pursue a career as a DBA, getting the proper qualifications, technical skills, and practical experience will determine whether a person has the potential to work with one of the above companies. title: How to Get a Cisco Networking Certification?
excerpt: Choose a Cisco certification track, study, practice hands-on, and take the exam via Pearson VUE. Recertify every 3 years through exams or credits.

body.text: Monday, October 14, 2024

Introduction In this rapidly changing IT world, a Cisco certification is highly valued by employers as it can validate that the professional possesses certain networking skills. Whether you work to become a network administrator, a systems engineer, or even a network architect, a Cisco certification can turn your life around. Here is how to get a Cisco Networking Certification easily. 1. Understand the Cisco Certification Levels Cisco is rather divided into several levels of certification for specific areas of interest: Entry Level: This includes the Cisco Certified Entry Networking Technician (CCENT), a great starting point for beginners who want to build foundational networking skills. Associate Level: The Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) is one of the most popular certifications and covers broad topics like networking fundamentals, IP services, security fundamentals, and automation. Professional Level: The Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) is ideal for individuals who want to specialize in more advanced areas, such as enterprise networking, security, data center, or wireless networks. Expert Level: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) is the highest level and is targeted at professionals who want to master networking skills. 2. Choose the Appropriate Certification Programme There are several tracks through Cisco, and you can choose one that suits your career requirements the best. The most popular among them are as follows: Enterprise: This is helpful when you have solid thoughts of specializing in enterprise networking. CCNA Enterprise comes to your rescue-the prime focus is on understanding enterprise networks and the underlying processes that go with them. Security: If you have a deep interest in cybersecurity, the CCNP Security or CCIE Security tracks are for you. Data Center: For those dealing with data and cloud infrastructures, CCNP Data Center is the right choice. Collaboration: CCNP Collaboration will be suited best for people who deal with voice, video, and conferencing-related technologies in the telecommunication field. Choose either of the paths according to your current job profile or career ambitions. Also Read: Top 10 Companies Hiring Database Administrators in India 3. Fulfill any requirements Some Cisco certifications have prerequisites. For example: CCNA: No formal requirements, although having a minimal knowledge of networking is very helpful. CCNP: It needs a hold of either the CCNA or at least equivalent knowledge. Besides that, prerequisite professional-level exams must be passed. CCIE: The candidate requires deep knowledge in the domain of networking and passing both a written and a hands-on lab exam. Make sure you fulfill the prerequisites before applying for the exam. 4. Study the Official Cisco Curriculum Cisco provides official resources and study guides, which are the best place to start. They offer a range of materials: Cisco’s Official Study Guides: Available for each certification level. These cover exam topics in detail and provide practical exercises. Cisco Networking Academy: Offers courses and training modules that help you prepare for exams. You can choose self-paced learning or instructor-led courses. Official Certification Guides: Books tailored to Cisco exams, providing focused content on what you need to know. 5. Practice by Doing In theory, but also hands-on preparation before one takes on the Cisco certifications, preparing for one is key. How to get there: Set Up a Home Lab: With this, you will have the chance to practice real-world networking scenarios. This allows one to set up routers, switches, and virtual machines in replicating complex networks. Practice Simulations: With the likes of Packet Tracer for Cisco and GNS3, the opportunity to simulate networking environments and experiment with different configurations is possible without having actual hardware to work on. 6. Leverage Practice Exams and Dumps First, you have to prepare yourself by giving practice tests before scheduling an appointment for a test. Websites, such as Boson, ExamTopics, and Cisco Learning Network, offer various practice tests for Cisco certifications. Practice Dumps: These will give you an idea about the type of questions asked in the test and also prepare you for the type of question formats. Review Weak Areas: When you have taken enough practice tests, review all your weak areas and focus on enhancing your knowledge in those topics. 7. Report and Take the Exam Once you feel prepared, you can enroll to sit for the exam. Cisco exams are delivered by Pearson VUE, which is a third-party testing provider that is independent of Cisco. Here is how you do it: Create a Cisco Account: You go to the Cisco Certification website and create your account. Select Exam and Testing Center: You can take an exam at Pearson VUE Testing Center or you can opt for the online proctored exam if available for the concerned certification. Exam Day Preparation: On the day of your exam ensure you have all necessary documents and materials ready for identification purposes. Relax and have a good sleep. 8. Recertification Retention Cisco certifications last 3 years. After which you have to recertify if you still want to maintain your knowledge about the CCNA domain. Cisco does provide three options for recertification: Take a Recertification Exam: You need to pass the same or higher-level exam to renew the certification. Acquire Continuing Education Credits: You earn credits by attending the webinars, workshops, or courses approved by Cisco, which add up toward recertification. Achieve higher certification: Passing a higher-level certification, such as CCNP after CCNA, will automatically renew your existing, lower-level certification. Conclusion: A Cisco certification opportunity often leads to many careers in networking, systems management, and even cybersecurity. Follow a study plan then gain practical experience by using official Cisco materials which will keep you well-prepared to pass your certification exams. Read our blogs | Visit our courses ​

title: Free Photo Editing Apps for Social Media
excerpt: Enhance your social media with free editing apps like Snapseed, Canva, and VSCO—ideal for students creating standout posts with ease!

body.text: Monday, October 14, 2024

Introduction When it comes to enhancing your social media presence, photo editing plays a crucial role in making your images stand out. Fortunately, there are many free photo editing apps available that offer a wide range of tools to help you create visually appealing content without breaking the bank. Whether you're adjusting brightness, adding filters, or fine-tuning details, these apps make it easy for anyone to elevate their photos and capture their audience's attention. 1. Snapseed For Accurate Editing Why It's Great: Snapseed is a powerful photo editing tool developed by Google. It brings to you a professional suite of features through an easy-to-use user interface. With Snapseed, you can fine-tune your photos or apply creative effects. Key Features: - Filters: Snapseed offers a ton of filters from vintage to modern giving your shots that special look. - Editing tools: such as selective adjustments, healing brushes, and perspective correction for minute details. - Easy-to-use interface: Snapseed is a user-friendly image editing tool even for new users. Ideal For: Students who need to make detailed adjustments or apply artistic filters to their photos. It's particularly useful for those who want to enhance their academic or personal photos with professional-quality edits. 2. Adobe Photoshop Express: The Professional Touch Why It's Great: Adobe Photoshop Express gives users a flavor of the company's legendary Photoshop capabilities in mobile-friendly form. It is a great option for students who want to have advanced features at their fingertips but do not want to clutter the full Photoshop software. Key Features: - Basic photo adjustments are easily available that adjust brightness, contrast, and color balance. - One-Touch Filters: With a wide variety of preset filters, seamlessly improve your images. - Text and Collage Options: Add your text overlay and photo collage to enhance the engagement of your posts. Ideal For: Students seeking a blend of simplicity and advanced features for both personal and project-related photo edits. It’s also a great tool for creating visually appealing presentations. 3. Pixlr: Creative and Versatile Why It Great: What sets Pixlr apart is its combination of user-friendliness with more advanced editing features. It offers a whole set of tools for both new users and professional editors. Key Features: - Auto-Fix Feature: One touch to perfect, making quick fixes incredibly easy. - Filter and Overlay Variety: Choose from an almost endless selection of filters and effects in your images. - Collage Maker: Make gorgeous collages with amazing layouts and designs. Ideal For: To be used by students who would love to try creative effects and need flexible editing capabilities for fast edits as well as more specific ones. 4. Canva: Why It's Great: Design and Edit in an Easy Peasy Way in Canva. It is just not a photo editor; it is something more of a design and creation tool that makes professional quality social media posts, such as presentations. Its ease of use and a vast library make it a student favorite. Key Features: - Pre-designed templates for social media posts, stories, and presentations are available. - Simple Photo Editing Tools: Makes it simple to adjust brightness and contrast; and apply filters. - Graphics and Fonts: Graphics, icons, and fonts-just like all these are used for making your design look beautiful. Ideal for: Students who want to make their social media posts, stories, and presentations most attractive and appealing. The interface of Canva design is ideal for those active in campus clubs or extracurricular activities. 5. VSCO: Chic and Minimalistic Why It's Great: VSCO has extremely high-quality filters and a rather minimalist user interface. It is perfect for users who want near-perfectly polished, professional-looking photos that don't require much work from the user themselves. Key Features: - High-Quality Filters: Apply premium filters that give your photos a unique and sleek look. - Basic Editing Tools: Make minor changes to exposure, contrast, and sharpness. - Easy Navigation: This application has a pretty simple interface that leans towards good aesthetics for your images. Ideal For: These are suitable for students who like the clean aesthetic and need to create visually attractive images to snap in quick steps. It's also really good for people who love sharing their personal work or creative output in a shareable space, such as Instagram. 6. InShot: Photo and Video Editing for Anything Why it's great: InShot comes with an entire set of image and video editing features. This makes it a great option for students who need to curate and edit all their multimedia files. Key Features: - Photo and Video Editing: Trim, crop, and apply effects to photos and videos - Collage Maker: Make customized layouts using InShot's collage-making feature. - Add text stickers and emojis to personalize your content. Ideal For: It is best suited for students performing multimedia projects or who want to create engaging content with pictures and videos included. It is an ideal application to capture and share pictures of events or personal experiences happening in the college. Conclusion ​ If you're ready to take your editing skills to the next level and create professional-quality content, why not explore more advanced tools? title: How Can I Become a Networking Engineer in 2024?
excerpt: Become a networking engineer in 2024 by gaining a relevant degree, certifications, hands-on experience, and mastering tech like cloud computing and 5G.

body.text: Friday, October 18, 2024

Introduction A networking engineer designs, implements, and manages computer networks that support voice, data, video, and wireless services. They ensure the smooth, secure, and efficient operation of networking systems. In 2024, it is more imperative than ever that network automation, cloud computing, and 5G technology have a well-designed and powerful kind of workforce in the form of skilled networking engineers. Steps to Becoming a Networking Engineer 1. Strong Education Foundation The first step into your career as a networking engineer is formal education. A bachelor's degree in fields like Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics and Communication Engineering can be highly recommended. However, some professionals initiate their journey with diploma programs or associate degrees in networking and related fields. - BCA degree that teaches students all about courses on networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and much more. - B.Tech or B.Sc in IT/Computer Science: These are courses that provide technical know-how relevant to networking roles. While it is not always a requirement to have a degree, definitely, this is the doorway to better job opportunities and a foundation for needed technical skills. Also read: How to Choose the Right BCA Program for Your Career? 2. Practical Experience No theory can make you a brilliant networking engineer unless you have experience practicing. Gain hands-on skills in the following: configuration and network troubleshooting. You can do this by: - Apply for internships with IT firms, telecommunication companies, or large enterprises. Work towards maintaining their networks. Practical experience will increase your confidence and your technical capabilities. - Home Labs Using tools such as Cisco Packet Tracer or GNS3, you will get to set up your home network lab with all abilities to real simulate real-world networking environments. - Practicals are a must as network engineers have to deal with intricate networks and troubleshoot issues in real-time. 3. Obtain Networking Certifications Networking certifications are important as they would prove your capability and give assurance to the employer about your skills. Currently, for a networking engineer in 2024, the most widely sought-after certifications include the following: - Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA): It is one of the most popular entry certifications that cover networking basics and would help act as a stepping stone for further degrees. - CompTIA Network+: Focuses on understanding of concepts in networking, troubleshooting, and basic security practices. - CCNP: Once you have mastered the basics, then this professional certification will boost your career into mastering the complex topics of more serious networking issues. - CISSP: With more and more cybersecurity considerations becoming important, it will add security expertise to your networking skills. These certifications are offered by organizations that are truly legitimate in the industry, such as Cisco, CompTIA, and Juniper Networks. Apart from making a person stand out against fellow applicants for a job, it also affects the actual salary that one will receive. 4. Train Soft Skills In addition to technical knowledge, today's networking engineer must possess some good soft skills too: - Problem-solving: Networks always seem to face problems at times, and you have to be equipped with the skills to identify and troubleshoot issues quickly. - Communication: It often involves task description of technical issues to team members who are not well versed in technology, thus, good communication is vital. - Teamwork: Networking engineers work in teams with developers, administrators, and IT managers, so teamwork is very helpful. These skills make for a balanced candidate who may not only heed the job technically but also be able to deal with the interpersonal requirements of the job. 5. Explore Advanced Networking Technologies The space of networking is dynamic and keeps on changing every time. For 2024, the focus areas of the industry are cloud computing, 5G, SDN (Software Defined Networking), and network automation. Keeping tabs on these technologies will prepare an individual for today's job market. - Cloud Networking: More infrastructure will be migrated to the cloud with the passage of time; there is a need in the field of networking engineering that know cloud platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure. - 5G Technology: Networking engineers must have a good understanding of 5G and its applicability to enterprise networks as well as to existing wireless technologies. - Network Automation: The use of ANSIBLE and Python scripting has evolved to be fundamental while managing networks at a large scale. Acquiring this advanced technology enables the opportunity of specialization within those fields of work and, thus, getting well-paying jobs. Conclusion Being a networking engineer in 2024 is not just exciting but also challenging. It requires a solid educational background, practical experience, essential certifications, and the ability to adapt to emerging technologies like cloud computing and 5G. Whether you’re starting from scratch or looking to upskill, our industry-recognized programs offer hands-on training that sets you apart in the competitive job market. title: Highest Paying Jobs in Virtualization and VMware
excerpt: Top VMware jobs in 2024: Architect, Engineer, Consultant, with salaries from ₹7L-₹18L. Required skills: VMware tools, cloud platforms, and virtualization securi

body.text: Friday, October 18, 2024

Introduction The IT world has come to accept virtualization as one of its most important technologies that can further help firms reduce resource utilization, save costs, and expand a business. In this regard, VMware has emerged as the leader in virtualization-a very popular platform for businesses across the world. As virtualization was increasingly implemented in various organizations, demands for professionals in this field skyrocketed along with very good long-term career opportunities. Lets see some of the highest paying jobs in virtualization and VMware. 1. VMware Architect Job Description: VMware Architects deal with designing and implementing VMware solutions in an organization. They work in collaboration with IT teams on the aspects of virtual environment development and management so as to ensure maximum performance and security. Key Responsibilities: - With VMware products you will design virtualized infrastructure. - The architecture should align with the business requirements and objectives. - Collaboration with the network, storage, and security teams to interconnect the VMware solution. Skills Required - Complete knowledge of VMware products, vSphere, vCenter, and NSX. - Must understand the strong ability of network and storage virtualization. - Hands-on experience both with cloud platforms and hybrid cloud integration. Average Salary: VMware Architects typically earn an annual salary ranging from ₹12,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 which is based on experience and location. Thinking about a career in virtualization? Check out Jetking's Diploma in Cloud Computing with AI —it’s a great place to start! 2. VMware Engineer Job Description: A VMware Engineer is expected to oversee the daily operation of a VMware environment in terms of maintenance. They must ensure that all Virtual Machines (VMs) are running efficiently and properly. Key Responsibilities: - Installation, configuration, and maintenance of VMware infrastructure - Monitor and optimize virtual environments in terms of performance and scalability - Troubleshooting VMs and virtualization issues. Required Skills: - VMware tools proficiency skills include vSphere, ESXi, and vRealize. - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure. - Knowledge of scripting languages, including PowerShell, for automation. Average Annual Salary: VMware Engineers generally earn an annual average salary ranging from ₹9,00,000 to ₹13,00,000 3. Cloud Virtualization Engineer Job Description: The role of a Cloud Virtualization Engineer comes up with solutions that integrate virtualization into the cloud environment. Virtualization engineers manage virtual resources along on-premises and cloud platforms. Key Responsibilities: - Deployment and management of virtual machines in cloud environments, for instance, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. - Implement hybrid cloud solutions with VMware Cloud on AWS and other VMware cloud services. - Seamless workload migration capability between on-premises and cloud environments. Skills Required: - Skilled in VMware cloud solutions including but not limited to VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware Cloud Director. - Knowledge in cloud platforms and services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). - Understanding of cloud concepts like network, storage, and security. Average salary: Cloud Virtualization Engineers typically earn an annual salary ranging from ₹10,00,000 to ₹15,00,000 4. VMware Systems Administrator Job Description: VMware Systems Administrators manage the virtual environments, configuring virtual machines and lifecycle-related activities. They also maintain the stability and security of virtual infrastructures. Key Responsibilities - VMWare ESXi server installation and configuration and vCenter server. - Virtual machine, template, snapshot, clone management. - Monitor the performance of the system and take regular backups. Skills Required: - Excellent knowledge of VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter. - Experience with the configuration of storage and network in virtual settings. - Understand backup and disaster recovery procedures for virtual machines. Average Salary: Salary of VMware Systems Administrators usually earn an annual salary ranging from ₹8,00,000 to ₹12,00,000 Also read: Top 10 Companies Hiring Cloud Computing Experts in India 5. Virtualization Consultant Job Description: Virtualization consultants work with clients to design virtualized systems tailored to a specific business need. These professionals provide an organization with best practice recommendations for how that organization can maximize the benefit from virtualization. Key Responsibilities: - Determine client needs and design a best-fit virtualization solution. - Introduction Deploying and optimizing VMware products for performance. - Engage with client teams to provide awareness and support on best practices for VMware. Skills Required: - Extensive experience with VMware products and virtualization concepts. - Strong communication and presentation skills for client interactions. - Ability to develop and deliver technical documentation and training materials. Average Salary: Virtualization Consultants can earn an annual salary ranging from ₹11,00,000 to ₹15,00,000, with the potential for higher earnings based on consulting fees and expertise. 6. VMware Instructor/Trainer Job Description: VMware Trainers or Instructors Train IT professionals on the company's VMware products and virtualization technology products. Conduct trainings, workshops, and certification courses. Key Responsibilities: - Delivering Training in VMware - Staying up-to-date with the new VMware-related technologies, as well as requirements for certification. - Facilitate learning for students to prepare for VMware certification exams. Skills Needed - General knowledge of VMware products and certification tracks. - An excellent communicator and teacher. - Experience in curriculum development and instructional design. Average Salary: VMware Trainers typically earn an annual salary ranging from ₹7,00,000 to ₹11,00,000, with additional potential income from freelance training and consulting opportunities. 7. Virtualization Security Specialist Job description: Virtualization security experts are involved in securing virtual environments. They apply the proper security measures to ward off threats and fulfill norms set by the industry. Key Responsibilities: - Designing and implementing security policies for virtual environments. - Monitor for security breaches and vulnerabilities in virtual machines. - Collaborating with IT security teams to integrate virtualization security as part of the overall IT security strategy. Required Skills: - VMware security tools, including vSphere Security Configuration Guide and NSX. - Dealing with compliance frameworks, like PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or ISO 27001. Average Salary: Virtualization Security Specialists generally earn an average annual salary ranging from ₹10,00,000 to ₹14,00,000. 8. VMware Product Manager Job Description: VMware Product Managers are tasked with developing and managing VMware products. Their work is closely related to the engineering groups, to whom they collaborate with so as to define a product roadmap that ensures VMware's products meet market needs. Key Responsibilities: - Defining product requirements and specifications based on customer feedback and market trends. - Collaborate with the engineering teams to design and deliver new features. - Prioritizing management for the product lifecycle and feature addition. Skills needed: - Good knowledge of VMware products and virtualization technologies. - Product management as well as development process experiences. - It is an ability to analyze market trends and customer needs. Average Salary: VMware Product Managers typically earn an annual salary ranging from ₹12,00,000 to ₹17,00,000, depending on their level of experience and the complexity of the products they manage. excerpt: VR is redefining gaming and other industries. Play top VR games in 2024 and explore Jetking’s program to kickstart a career in VR and metaverse technology.

body.text: Thursday, October 31, 2024

Introduction Virtual reality continues to break all records year by year. As one might expect, 2024 is no different. In gaming, VR experiences bring users closer than ever to their favorite worlds by providing immersive, interactive, and visually stunning experiences. For Indian students and gamers who want to be at the forefront of gaming technology, here are the top VR games you should try this year. Be it fast-paced action, mind-bending puzzles, or adrenaline-packed survival, you're bound to find something here. 1. Half-Life: Alyx The most polished VR game ever made, Half-Life: Alyx resets the bar on what you can do with VR. Being inside the Half-Life universe full of rich details, you can interact with nearly everything in your surroundings. A must-try for those in search of AAA-quality gaming in VR, it fills the gap that fans of the series had found themselves with between Half-Life 1 and 2. 2. Beat Saber Beat Saber is a rhythm and precision-based VR game. Swing your lightsabers through color-coded blocks by the beat of great, high-energy music in this half-workout, half-game performance - you'll have to physically move to hit those targets in time with the beat. The satisfaction of slicing through those blocks just so while grooving to energetic beats has long made Beat Saber one of the most popular VR titles around. 3. The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners If you are a fan of survival horror, you do not want to pass up this game. The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners will make you feel like you're living in a post-apocalyptic world consumed by zombies. Combat gets intense at times, but resource management is crucial for scrounging resources and gathering supplies. It's one of the most engaging survival games in VR with a mix of strategy and action. Also read: Highest Salary of AR & VR Experts in India. 4. Superhot VR Superhot VR is not just a shooter; it's a real-time strategic puzzle. Time goes by if you move. What makes it feel unique is that you are planning your every move carefully to avoid bullets and beat the enemies. Every move feels like an action movie scene. This is one of the most unique gameplay mechanics in VR. 5. The Hike 2 Ever wanted to climb those sky-high cliffs without the danger? With Climb 2, players get to enjoy the scenery and heights from safely tethered to their VR headset. It lets the players climb structures, cliffs, and landmarks using climbing movements. The impressive graphics and immersive mechanics of this game make it great for adrenaline junkies. Some More Cool VR experiences worth trying out. VRChat: A social hub for gamers to interact, explore, and create their virtual worlds. No Man's Sky VR: An exploratory spacecraft with experience of endless space—a full virtual reality experience of this limitless universe. Resident Evil 4 VR: If you love classic survival horror, the VR version of Resident Evil 4 is guaranteed to have you jumping in your seat. Why You Should Start Exploring VR Now Here is the point: while VR games are certainly entertaining, no one would ever guess that being on one end of a global revolution beyond gaming promises much more than that. Education and healthcare are on the list of fields changing based on the information being reinforced through new platforms. The more accessible it becomes; the quicker one will find an opportunity to get involved with this new technology in India today. How VR is Revolutionizing Other Businesses Education: it is being changed by VR in many more ways beyond gaming. It is making learning more interactive and accessible through virtual classrooms and labs. Healthcare: Surgery Doctors perform surgery and practice using VR. They can also engage in therapy sessions with the use of VR. Architecture: VR allows architects to imagine 3D visualizations of their designs, walked through, before they exist in the building. The possibilities in VR are infinite, which is why it is an essential set of skills for anyone interested in the tech. Start your journey with Jetking's Masters in Gaming & Metaverse Design (JK-MGMD) Grab high-end career opportunities in the fast-growing metaverse and gaming industries. This program leads you from 3D VR artists to Metaverse Unity Developers- giving you the mastery skills for high-end, cutting-edge employment roles. Also with Specialized courses in VFX, Motion Graphics & Animation, and UX Design - it offers a multi-pathway career. The metaverse is expected to reach $1.6 trillion by 2030 , so now is the perfect time to upskill and future-proof your career with Jetking. Conclusion From cutting beats in Beat Saber to surviving the zombie apocalypse in The Walking Dead, VR just brings in a level of immersion that cannot be matched when experiencing the same experience on a TV or monitor. And if VR gets you all excited, all you have to do is play and think about learning how to build these amazing experiences at institutes like Jetking. This is the best time to upskill because the future is increasingly lining up towards virtual environments. Happy Gaming! ​ Read our blogs | Visit our courses
